title: Dot Patterns and Five Frames
short: Know dot patterns and five frames up to 5.

blocks.html: Dots can make patterns you know, like on a die or a domino. Four dots make a square. Five dots are four corners and one in the middle!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Four corners and one in the middle make 5.

blocks.html: Dot patterns and five frames help you see a number without counting one by one.

blocks.title: A five frame
blocks.q: A five frame has 5 boxes. 3 are full. How many are empty?

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Play a board game with a die. Your child will learn the dot patterns by heart. Draw five boxes on paper and fill some with buttons: “How many full? How many empty?” A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Play a simple dice game together.
Make a five frame from an egg carton cut down to 5 cups.
